lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Docs-only fix from review round 2 (CAM-360): the README.md command reference table (the fenced block starting at 'cam init [options]') listed cam status/stop/drain/resume but omitted the first-class 'cam pause' subcommand that US-003 had already wired into index.ts's COMMANDS array, HELP registry, and PAUSE_HELP. Added one line ('cam pause  Set the operator pause brake marker (.claude/.cam-pause), separate from loop state') between 'cam stop' and 'cam drain', matching the description text index.ts already uses for the command-list entry and PAUSE_HELP tagline. No source/behavior change; index.ts/pause.ts/status.ts were untouched. If a future story touches the command reference table again, keep the alphabetical-by-lifecycle ordering (status/stop/pause/drain/resume) that groups the three operator-brake commands (stop/pause/drain) together.
